STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_10624_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: mg_10624_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_10624 (readMode,writeMode,inputBit,outputBit,clk,rst);
input readMode, writeMode, clk, rst; 
  input inputBit; 
  output outputBit; 
  reg outputBit; 
  reg [7:0] curData; 
  reg [2:0] topPtr; 
  always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) 
  if (rst) begin 
  topPtr <= 3'h0; 
  curData <= 8'h00; 
  end else begin 
  if (readMode) begin 
  {curData, outputBit} <= {1'b0, curData}; 
  topPtr <= topPtr - 1; 
  end else if (writeMode) begin 
  curData[topPtr] <= inputBit; 
  topPtr <= topPtr + 1; 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
